test_title: PYST 3: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 16th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Six girls A, B, C, D, E and F stand in two vertical lines; all girls face the north. three girls are there in each line. E is immediately behind D. F is to the left of A. C is just ahead of B. A is immediately ahead of D. Which two girls stand in the last position of lines?
solution:
Six girls A, B, C, D, E and F stand in two vertical lines; all girls face the north. three girls are there in each line.

1) A is immediately ahead of D and E is immediately behind D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/03ca01f71b78cb748ccc61830f18829fda18bd401302ea120bcaab82a3dbf503.png] 

2) F is to the left of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bbba23c799dfdee976633f49502aaf80cdf703d96a360360bb951208776a271c.png] 

3) C is just ahead of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb2ff19ef02a25faec49eb6b3fa98c9cd534163b19ed74ea2d3cce78b8a88d6f.png] 

∴ Here, B, E are two girls stands in last position of lines.

Hence, the correct answer is **"B, E".**
